# COR050 `missing-accessibility-statement`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

A module has no default accessibility statement (`private` or `public`).

## Why

Without a default the module exports everything it declares or uses, including helpers and the
entities of every module it uses. Start with `private` and mark the API `public` explicitly.

## Reported

```fortran
module grid
implicit none
```

## Preferred

```fortran
module grid
implicit none
private
public :: grid_t
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[COR050] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = COR050` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/cookbook/analysis#choose-the-rules).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `C131` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
